# go-modern-slices-collect

**Since:** Go 1.23

## Summary

Use slices.Collect to build a slice from an iterator.

## Details

slices.Collect materializes an iterator into a slice when a slice is actually required.
Prefer ranging over the iterator directly when streaming is enough.

## Examples

### Before

```go
keys := make([]string, 0, len(m))
for k := range m {
  keys = append(keys, k)
}
```

### After

```go
keys := slices.Collect(maps.Keys(m))
```
